actor.name: Microsoft Agent 365 / Foundry model router / Copilot Studio
actor.description: Agent 365 governs Microsoft, partner and third-party agents; model router routes prompts across OpenAI/Anthropic/xAI/DeepSeek/Meta models within Azure Policy-governed subsets, honoring data zones.

note: Copilot Business SMB bundle (~$21/user/mo, secondary). Traction: Agent 365 GA 2026-05-01 at $15/user/mo (https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2026/05/01/microsoft-agent-365-now-generally-available-expands-capabilities-and-integrations/). Licence: Proprietary.
